policy: References informed proportions, fin layout and the placement of the black/white storm pattern only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture, tracing or proportion source; public breeder descriptions guided identity only. Body stations were derived from the accepted Ocellaris morphology profile and corrected per the user's side-profile feedback.

referenceGradeRationale: Species anatomy is well documented (FishBase counts, accepted project profile, openly licensed lateral photographs of wild-type A. ocellaris); the Black Storm colour layout follows published breeder descriptions and the user's brief rather than calibrated imagery, and top/front views are inferred from general Pomacentridae body plans.
